Beginner — fundamentals and workflow
- Premiere Pro: Adobe’s Learn & Support (official tutorials) — step‑by‑step lessons on the interface, timeline, cuts, and export settings.

- YouTube channels: Justin Odisho, Peter McKinnon, and Cinecom.net — practical beginner tutorials on cuts, transitions, and editing workflows.

Intermediate — color, audio, effects, motion graphics
- Color grading: MixingLight and Juan Melara (online tutorials) — deep dives on color theory, scopes, and grading workflows (also applies to Lumetri and Resolve).  
- Audio: Designing Sound for Film & TV tutorials; Adobe Audition tutorials (or Audacity basics) — learn noise reduction, EQ, and mixing dialog/music.  
- Motion graphics: School of Motion and Video Copilot — After Effects fundamentals, animation principles, and practical templates.  
- Effects & compositing: Video Copilot (Optical Flares, Element 3D), Andrew Kramer tutorials.

Advanced / professional workflows
- Color grading book: "Color Correction Handbook" by Alexis Van Hurkman — thorough technical and creative grading guide (Resolve/Lumetri concepts transferable).  
- Editing craft: "In the Blink of an Eye" by Walter Murch — theory on cuts, rhythm, and storytelling.  
- Online masterclasses: MasterClass (e.g., Werner Herzog, Martin Scorsese for storytelling), FXPHD for VFX/advanced post.  
- Multi‑cam and finishing: Ripple Training and Lynda/LinkedIn Learning advanced Premiere/Resolve courses on multicam, proxies, mastering deliverables.

Practice + community + assets
- Project practice: Film Riot and Cinecom project breakdowns with downloadable practice footage.  
- Stock footage/music: Pexels, Pixabay (free), Artlist/Epidemic Sound (paid) for practicing edits with licensed music.

- Templates & presets: Motion Array, Envato Elements for lower‑thirds, LUTs, transitions to learn how professionals structure projects.

3. Do small projects (30–60s edits) using free stock clips + music.
